Hi Evelyn / Sam —

Thanks again for the chat last week. Per Sam's ask, I'd like to lock in a 30m technical demo to show how Redwood's inference runtime can cut P95 latency and reduce token cost for your search relevance pipeline.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Aug 18, 10:00–10:30
- Wed Aug 19, 14:00–14:30
- Thu Aug 20, 09:00–09:30

Agenda (attached: cloudcrest-demo-agenda.pdf):
1) 5m — goals and success criteria (your side)
2) 15m — live demo: low-latency serving + routing fallbacks
3) 5m — cost/ops implications and rollout patterns
4) 5m — next steps and pilot cadence

If none of those work, tell me a good window and we’ll adapt. Also looping Marissa and Karthik to align on the pilot checklist and next steps (contracts/procurement).

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
